title: Chapter 618
paragraphs: Chapter 618
Episode 159. Two Kings' Great War (5)
"Why, why don't you just say you're going to kill me outright? You've got the look in your eyes that you could."
It's not that it wasn't true, Kaiyo really had that look in his eyes. It was enough to make one shudder, even when trying to deliberately provoke him.
Although he was laughing on the outside, his throat was dry.
'I can't even play the villain. Wow, this is scary.'

Lafra Rosa came and purified the chaos, regained all his strength, and gained even more enlightenment through the fusion of the two gods. He never imagined he would feel such a deep and heavy pressure from Kaiyo's 'momentum'.
He has known for a long time that Kaiyo is one of the top warriors of the Myeongwang clan.
When he was conducting the opening ceremony with the fusion of the two gods, all the two kings fought with Kaiyo's assistance.
Kaiyo controlled everyone with a single bow, and that arrow was the most troublesome and threatening attack even in the state of the fusion of the two gods.
"Begin the 22nd war."
As soon as Vahn finished speaking, lightning gathered like a storm on Kaiyo's great bow 'Shinsal'.
Although energy was gathered in Sigmund, it was a little late.
It was a difference that could only be recognized at least at the level of the two kings. When the sword and arrow collided, the warriors perceived that the two attacked simultaneously.
It was heavy.
It felt completely different from Teto, Garmund, Palem, and Dalfir, who he had competed with so far.
Especially in the previous two games, even though he lost, he thought that if he used the Myeongwang Gunrim sword to its limit, the result might have been different.
But this time, he could be sure from the first strike. As of now, he cannot beat Kaiyo in a 'fair fight'.
'It seems there might be a possibility if I keep training.'
If the current growth rate continues, it won't take too long. The sense of the fusion of the two gods is rapidly growing Jin.
Crack-!
Each time he knocked away the arrows that flew in succession, a dull impact shook his body.
As if there was no need for a scouting war, Kaiyo was pressing Jin from the beginning with full power.
Jin barely kept up with his rhythm. It may have looked like a close fight to the warriors, but the two kings had already determined that the game was in Kaiyo's favor.
That was natural.
Even the warriors who feel that the two are fighting equally now considered the 22nd war to be a battle with a predetermined outcome.
'It's a matter of time. With this momentum, Jin will soon get tired.'
'I hope Kaiyo doesn't hurt Jin too much...'
Those who argue that Jin, as a successor, should test again with other two kings, and those who see him as a confirmed successor.
Everyone was worried about that. When Kaiyo said, "There might be an accident," it wasn't a voice that only Jin heard.
"Didn't you say you could definitely beat me? That's disappointing."
"Why don't you shoot one more arrow instead of talking. I can still bear it... ugh!"
The scattered lightning from the shattered arrow pierced his left arm. The fragment embedded deep enough to touch the bone was not an accident but Kaiyo's intention.
What Jin shattered was not an arrow but a 'San Shi San Shi'.
Unlike a fragmentation bomb from a magic cannon, all the fragments of Kaiyo's San Shi moved according to his will.
Jin did not experience Kaiyo's San Shi during the opening ceremony.
At that time, he had to concentrate the destructive power to the limit in order to pierce the energy of Jin who had spread the God Fusion, so he did not use it.
In addition, he did not take it out to other brothers while recording three victories, so it was a completely unexpected attack for Jin.
Severe bleeding followed as the fragments lodged in his left arm were removed. And Jin had no choice but to take another hit in the injured area from the second San Shi that followed.
'This is no joke.'
A big move is definitely needed to change the situation.
But Kaiyo did not give Jin even a speck of time. So far, he had fought many opponents, but it felt like Kaiyo was the first to not even give him a chance to catch his breath.
He can't close the distance.
Kaiyo shot arrows from all around, running around like the wind. It seemed like not one, but about a dozen archers were shooting.
'In comparison, Julian's Thunderbow Harumila seems cute.'
He felt as if he was the archer with the power of the Storm God.
Even if he barely succeeded in defense, he could not move from his place as the San Shi exploded whenever there was a gap.
He changed his sword.
"Spirit Sword Ultimate Skill? Ah, looking at it now, it seems that the Jin brothers believed in it. Yes, that sword is a little dangerous."
Saying so, Kaiyo immediately increased his firepower even more.
Jin's Spirit Sword Ultimate Skill did not even open the signs that blocked Lingling's senses.
Because the curtain of spiritual energy trying to dye the main hall was being torn by Kaiyo's lightning.
It wasn't completely ineffective. The accuracy of the bow dropped due to the blocked view, and a considerable amount of energy was wasted in pushing out the spiritual energy.
"Jin brothers, you know very well that it's meaningless to waste time like this."
Every time he thought it would stop at this point, the firepower of Shin-sal increased.
Eventually, Jin had to convert the spiritual energy scattered around into demonic sword energy without fully unfolding the Spirit Sword Ultimate Skill.

Even that was not complete. He couldn't spread any skills properly while his whole body was shaking from the shock like a ship caught in a storm. He couldn't even borrow the power of Tess, which was most important.
However, the Upfire showed tremendous power. He burned the arrows, pushed back the energy, and even covered Kaiyo as he spread.
The strong enemy that came to Jin's mind at that moment was Hedo, the tower keeper of Baekya. The unstable Upfire had about the destructive power of the moment he hit Hedo in the Sota Desert.
And Kaiyo showed a monstrous strength to easily shake off the dark flames and heat, just like Hedo did then.
If the power of Tess had been added and used in full, even Kaiyo would not have been able to accept it so easily.
"But in a battle, hypothetical scenarios mean nothing.
Therefore, Kaiyo didn't feel much excitement about Jin's Upwha.
Swish-!
Black sword energies were gushing out through the blue flames. Kaiyo began to close the distance with Jin, smoothly avoiding the sword energy.
It wasn't because he was underestimating Jin enough to give up the advantage of controlling the distance. Rather, it was a choice made to more definitively finish Jin off.
The closer he gets, the more destructive the divine arrows become. The psychic energy that was engulfing the entire sanctuary was converging towards Kaiyo as the two got closer.
It was like narrowing the palm of a hand. Even though the area corroded by Kaiyo's psychic energy was shrinking, Jin couldn't spread his own energy there. A stronger force continued to suppress Jin.
The spiritual barrier that he had laid out two steps ahead was being penetrated.
Having lost the last line of defense, Jin now had to endure the divine arrows of ShinSal that had begun to infiltrate within.

Maintaining an overwhelmingly advantageous state by corroding all of the opponent's territory with psychic energy is one of the characteristics of Myung Wang Gun Rim Sword. Kaiyo's technique resembled that.
Crack-! Tswaaak!
While desperately blocking the arrows, another Sansi exploded. When the third Sansi exploded, Jin felt his vision darken momentarily.
Eyes.
Two fragments precisely pierced Jin's eyes.
Thanks to Moulta's rune and the shield, he wasn't actually pierced, but his head rang so much that he felt dizzy.
"You won't be able to block the next one, are you okay, Jin? It seems better to shout for mercy."
Ten steps, somehow the distance between Jin and Kaiyo had narrowed to that extent.
As Kaiyo said, Moulta's rune was exactly in a state where the eye area was completely torn.
A cold sweat ran down his spine. The moment the eyeball is shattered, even with Boras's healing ability, it could never be reversed.
Now, because of the psychic war and the spiritual barrier outside, no one could accurately know how their battle was going.
Even if Jin really lost his eyes, it would just be an 'accident'.
His heart pounded like crazy.
'If I step back, I can never achieve what I aimed for.'
The Martial Emperor Tournament, a fight to determine the successor of Martial God.
In that fight, all the Myung Wang clans stake their lives. Compared to that, the eyes were not expensive.
Even more so if it was a price to unite the brothers as a villain.
"You've gotten weak. If it were me, I wouldn't have warned you and taken your eyes immediately, Kaiyo."
"That's why I'm going to do that."
Kaiyo released the bowstring he had drawn."
Then, along with the divine arrows on the bow, all the arrows that were set up like pillars here and there simultaneously rained down on Jin.
Even if it was obscured by psychic and spiritual energy, it was a movement large enough for all the brothers outside to recognize.
The Myung Wang clans gasped in surprise.
"So the Shiptuwang brothers...!"
"Damn it, there was no need to go that far! He could have easily incapacitated him!"
"This is wrong. Tushin brothers, you need to mediate!"
"It's already too late... As the Shiptuwang brothers said, Jin should have declared to give up the tournament before this happened. Or we should have stepped in and stopped it."
Kuaaak-!
Jin let out a scream in a broken voice.
Finally, an accident had occurred.
After about ten seconds had passed, the massive forces that had shaken the sanctuary so far seemed to be calming down as if they were all false.

After the sight was secured, what the Myung Wang clans saw was Jin, who was pouring blood from his whole face with arrows stuck all over his body, and Kaiyo, who was catching his breath and looking down at him.
The Myung Wang clans couldn't blame Kaiyo. The Martial Emperor Tournament was originally such a fight, and he had simply given his all.
The Martial Emperor tactics he had been showing all along were a huge burden for Kaiyo as well. Barely supporting his trembling legs, he aimed a divine arrow at Jin, who had finally fallen.
"Hoo, hoo..."
The aim announcing victory, if he releases the bowstring, Jin will surely die.
Vahn watched this scene for a moment.
"The 22nd tournament...."
However, the moment Vahn was about to declare the end,
Suddenly, Jin, who had fallen, jumped up and stabbed Bradamante into Kaiyo's chest. With the sword in his mouth.
"Crazy, what's this!"
"Jin brother!?"
Although he moved incredibly fast for someone full of arrows, it was not a speed that Kaiyo couldn't react to.
But Kaiyo couldn't do anything about Bradamante that had pierced his chest. In order to avoid being stabbed, he had no choice but to let go of the bowstring that was aimed at Jin's head.
"You, you...!"
Even while being stabbed in the chest, Kaiyo did not let go of the bowstring.
Meanwhile, Jin, as if he was really going to kill Kaiyo, twisted his head and even swung the sword stuck in his chest.
"I told you, Kaiyo... You can't beat me. Never."
Then, as the energy of Bradamante exploded inside the chest, an arrow grazed Jin's cheek and split the sky.
Kaiyo fell spitting out blood, and Jin, trembling, lost consciousness after looking down at him for a few seconds.
